[COMPANY_LEGAL_NAME]
AUDIT LOG TEMPLATE

Purpose

This Audit Log Template provides [COMPANY_LEGAL_NAME] with a standardized format for recording and tracking compliance audits, security assessments, and internal reviews. This template ensures consistent audit documentation that supports compliance evidence requirements and continuous improvement.

Scope

This template applies to all [COMPANY_NAME] internal and external audits, compliance assessments, security reviews, and management reviews. It applies to all personnel involved in conducting, supporting, or responding to audits.

Governance and Cross-Package References

This template supports audit documentation requirements across all [COMPANY_ABBREVIATION] compliance packages.

Universal [COMPANY_ABBREVIATION] Principles - Audit Documentation:
No Sensitive Data in Logs: Audit logs and evidence must NOT contain PII, PHI, PCI, CUI, or other regulated identifiers in unprotected form; use anonymized references
Data-as-Regulated: Audit documentation treated as Confidential; access restricted to audit team and authorized personnel

Cross-Package Integration:
security-governance skill (Security & Compliance Handbook): Master governance document establishing audit requirements
internal-compliance skill (Compliance Management Framework): Audit program governed by compliance management framework
internal-compliance skill (Audit Logging and Monitoring Policy): Technical audit logging requirements
contracts-risk-assurance skill (Compliance Audit Checklist): Audit checklist used during compliance audits

For compliance audit requirements, see internal-compliance skill (Compliance Management Framework).
For compliance audit checklist, see contracts-risk-assurance skill (Compliance Audit Checklist).

Audit Program Management

Program Governance
Audit program governed by CISO
Annual audit plan developed based on risk and compliance requirements
Audit plan approved by CISO and management
Audit program reviewed annually for effectiveness

Audit Independence
Internal auditors independent from areas being audited
External auditors selected based on qualifications and independence
Audit objectivity maintained throughout process
Conflicts of interest documented and managed

Audit Records Retention
Audit plans retained for minimum 7 years
Audit reports retained for minimum 7 years
Audit evidence retained for minimum 7 years
Audit finding remediation records retained for minimum 7 years
Records stored securely per records management policy
